name: Rudra WC Test Data Generator
author: Rahul Ranjan

sections.description:
Rudra WC Test Data Generator helps developers quickly create safe sample customers, products, orders and coupons for development, QA and demonstrations.

V1 is intentionally small and has hard server-side limits:
* 20 customers
* 50 products
* 100 orders
* 10 coupons
* 5 variations per variable product

Generated records are marked so they can be safely removed from the plugin’s admin page.

This plugin is intended for development and staging websites. Do not use it on a production store.

Features

  • Dummy registered customers using example.com addresses.
  • Simple and variable products.
  • Historical dummy orders.
  • Simple percentage and fixed-cart coupons.
  • Safe cleanup of plugin-generated data only.
  • WooCommerce CRUD APIs for products, orders and coupons.
  • HPOS-compatible order creation and deletion.
  • No external APIs, telemetry, license server or tracking.

Safety

Do not use this plugin on a production store. Generated data can affect store reports and admin screens.

Uninstalling the plugin does not delete generated data.

Use the Delete All Generated Data button when you explicitly want to remove generated records.

Privacy

This plugin does not send data to external services.

Dummy customer emails use example.com.

License

GPLv2 or later.

Generation is queued and processed in short WordPress background batches so the browser request does not wait for the full dataset.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload or install this plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Dummy Data.
  5. Generate the data needed for your development or staging site.
